pages.title: Exotic Matter
pages.text: Matter with negative energy density, the stuff wormholes and warp drives require. It pushes against gravity, bends light the wrong way, and sits in its flask like a pool of shadow that is somehow lighter than air.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Separating dimensional residue in the Fractionation Spire, one fraction refused to sink or rise in the usual way. It had negative energy density. The exotic matter of Morris and Thorne, distilled from leftovers.

Made in $(item)Fractionation Spire$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): White Holes.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Alcubierre Coil, Cherenkov Quartz, Compactified Circle, Cosmic String Lens, D-Brane Sheet, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Dilithium Crystal, Dimensional Residue and more.
